title: Natsume's Book of Friends
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Orphaned teenager Takashi Natsume can see yokai and spirits, which made him an outcast as he was passed between relatives. Now settled with kind guardians in the countryside (AniList Adoption, Rural), he inherits his late grandmother Reiko's Book of Friends, which holds the names of spirits she bound to her will. With a cat-shaped guardian spirit, Natsume returns the names one by one and learns to trust both humans and yokai.
life_message: Kindness, patience and keeping faith with others, human or spirit, heal loneliness and make a home.

content.note: Hostile spirits seek to harm Natsume; Nyanko-sensei protects him (Wikipedia; AniList Exorcism 56).
Some menacing spirits amid a gentle tone (AniList Iyashikei 90, Youkai 93).
The guardian spirit drinks sake with other yokai (to verify).
Loneliness, bullying and rejection of an orphan (MU Loneliness, Bullying; AniList Orphan, Rehabilitation).
Hides spirit encounters from guardians (to verify).
